en: Black‑and‑white image showing a group of uniformed soldiers manning a field artillery gun in a muddy field. The men wear pickelhaube-style spiked helmets and late‑19th/early‑20th‑century uniforms, suggesting a European (likely German) army. Several soldiers kneel by ammunition baskets near the gun carriage while others stand behind, one officer pointing into the distance. In the right background stands a traditional wooden windmill with large sails.
